license: Repository-owned Qin-terracotta research asset; no third-party geometry or bitmap textures
visualIntent: barded war horse with a jade chamfron
periodPolicy: Qin terracotta visual fantasy: no gunpowder artillery; cannon role is represented by a heavy siege crossbow

scale.policy: one factor for all axes; the sculpt's proportions are preserved

derivation: Sculpted research GLB scaled uniformly onto the plinth, decimated per LOD, then bound island by island to the shared runtime rig, actions, sockets and faction palette contract
knownLimitations: each sculpted island follows one bone; only the torso and sleeves blend between bones
source colours and clay shading are baked to vertex colours; bitmap normal maps are intentionally absent
canonical runtime actions are adapters and may be iterated without changing the visual source authority

texturePolicy.solidColorBake: COLOR_0 VEC3 exact RGB reference colors with shading in _SHADE; one horse_terracotta_vertex_palette material
